answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in tundra, expire in glacier, and garden lists each expiry. An attacker running 130 aliases therefore needs 41 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2730 identities would post 1518 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
